name: Blocky Volumetric Clouds
definition: A volumetric cloud rendering technique that uses a 2D texture sampled at the cloud layer's Y-coordinate to determine density, creating a 'blocky' appearance distinct from noise-based realistic clouds.
summary: Blocky Volumetric Clouds is a procedural technique generating cartoon-style clouds via 2D texture sampling, differing from noise-based methods by using a static density map for voxel-style consistency.
